description: Pile of about 30 whole raw almonds cut out on transparent (1200x1200, subject 1008px = 8% padding); crisp edges, no bowl; cut from the Mockup Graphics studio shot.
Heaped white bowl of whole almonds on a soft off-white surface, warm and clean, no text; a different shot from the cut-out source (nicer natural look).
Round wooden bowl of pale whole cashews (W320-style, creamy white), top-down, cut out on transparent; the bowl is part of the cut-out.
Same top-down bowl of pale whole cashews on pure white with a soft shadow; square 1600x1600.
Two small wooden bowls cut out on transparent: one of shelled walnut kernels (halves and pieces), one of in-shell walnuts; clean edges, reflection removed.
Natural studio shot of the same two wooden bowls (walnut kernels and in-shell walnuts) on a glossy white surface with soft reflections; no text.

Three thick slices of a date/fig-and-nut bar packed with cashews, almonds and sesame, cut out on transparent. So-so match: rectangular slabs (not square/diamond), Italian panforte-style date-nut bar rather than Indian barfi, dark brown, slightly soft focus; loaf behind was masked out.
Natural landscape shot of the same date-and-nut slices on baking paper over a wooden board (end of the uncut loaf visible top left); warm, no text. Same so-so caveat as the cut-out.

Banner: five white bowls of cashews, almonds, walnut kernels, pistachios and dates on dark wood, low moody light; dark empty space on the left and top for text. Dates stand in for raisins (no raisins in this shot); bowls sit centre-right so left copy room is about 20% wide plus the dark top.

Square crop (1200x1200) for a round category tile: four white bowls of almonds, cashews, walnut kernels and pistachios with a few loose nuts on dark wood; no dates or raisins. A faint signature at the very top of the original is cropped out.
